mentions.name: Val
mentions.description: A fully fledged, developer-experience-focused CMS that stores content in TypeScript/JavaScript files. It is fully type-safe with no type generation step, supports renaming and refactoring content from the IDE, and needs no cloud APIs, databases, caching, query language, or sign-up to get started. Designed to work well across a project's lifetime from initial build through PRs to decommissioning, it pairs well with AI coding tools like Cursor thanks to local content, schema, strong type safety, and validation. It currently requires Next.js and GitHub; the APIs are fairly stable and the UI is being revamped.
